entities.name: Leonard of Chios
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leonard of Chios, also called Leonardo Giustiniani, was a Greek scholar of the Dominican Order and Latin Bishop of Mytilene, best known for his eye-witness account of the Fall of Constantinople in 1453, which is one of the main sources for the event.
